_about: The Automated Trickster ruleset (Stage E). Declarative and Loudon-editable — change rules here without a deploy. The engine evaluates a request against these rules IN ORDER; the first matching rule wins. If no rule matches, default_verb applies. TWO things this file CANNOT override: (1) the audition/irreversible HARD GATE (audition-gate.js) runs BEFORE any rule and always escalates sensory auditions and irreversible/destructive actions; (2) when the daily budget is exhausted, an auto-grant rule is downgraded to escalate. Both are code, not rules, on purpose.
_q1_decision: v0 auto-grants ONLY non-blocking directional forks that carry the steward's own recommendation. The strawman's 'advances forward_vector + cost below threshold' is encoded as the deterministic proxies the engine can actually check from a message: blocking:false + has steward_recommendation + within daily budget. blocking:true, every audition, every irreversible action, and every unmatched resource escalate. read_palace (grant) and web_search-over-budget (deny) rules are DORMANT — no such requests are on the board today; they carry the vocabulary forward.
match_predicates_supported: resource_in (array of resource tokens; coalesced top-level||payload)
over_daily_budget (boolean; requires a live budget state)

rules.rationale: Non-blocking directional fork carrying the steward's own recommendation. blocking:false means the steward already proceeded on its best guess and is not suspended; the grant ratifies its recommended direction. Lowest-stakes automatable decision. Subject to the daily auto-grant budget.

Palace-internal read / semantic search: no external cost, fully reversible, no creative or directional commitment. DORMANT — zero such requests on the live board today; this rule fires only if that resource type later appears.

rules.deny_reason: Daily web_search budget exhausted. Use palace material, or this can be escalated to Loudon for an explicit grant.
rules.rationale: External web_search beyond the daily search budget. DORMANT — zero web_search requests on the live board today. When the budget is NOT exhausted this rule does not match, so a within-budget web_search falls through to default_verb (escalate) rather than being auto-granted — external reach always gets a human or an explicit dormant grant rule, never a silent auto-grant.
